physicalScale: Mesh UV = metres/2; manifest tiling converts to world period; rug UV is unique 0..1 on 2.8 x 1.8 m; leaf UV is unique 0..1 on nominal 0.13 x 0.32 m.
normalConvention: Tangent +Y / OpenGL, PNG rows run opposite UV V; no green flip.

channels.Occlusion: linear local cavity only, not directional baked lighting
channels.Height: 16 bit normalized; physical min/max given for each family
